olivia (infra-eng): Heads-up: I'm proposing a tf module change for gpupools and kms handling. Need feedback before I open the PR.

jamal (sre): TL;DR? what are the user-visible changes?

olivia (infra-eng): - add provider version guard var+validation
- add region_capacity map var for per-region sizing
- split kms alias resource to avoid replacement on key rotation
- bump module major, keep a compatibility shim in root module

marie (platform): can the kms alias split cause terraform to delete existing alias? last time we had replacement

olivia (infra-eng): Good question. Plan is: create new aws_kms_alias resource with lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true } and null_resource migration to copy alias target. Then mark old alias for lifecycle ignore_changes until we flip traffic. Example:

```
resource "aws_kms_alias" "new" {
  name          = "alias/rw-gpupool-${var.region}"
  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.gpukey[each.key].key_id
  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }
}
```

jamal (sre): We need a safe state migration step. Suggest: 1) apply module in canary region with new alias resource 2) run `terraform state mv` to point alias to new resource 3) cutover 3) remove old resource. Also ensure dynamodb lock active

olivia (infra-eng): Agreed. I'll add a migration doc in the PR. Also adding a provider constraint var so we don't accidentally upgrade to provider versions that change behaviour. Proposing default: ">= 4.55.0, < 5.0.0"

marie (platform): How will gitops handle the module major bump? Argo will notice changes in the module refs repo

olivia (infra-eng): Plan: - publish module v2.0.0 to registry - update modulerefs repo in a branch and open canary PR for argocd to sync to a non-prod cluster - monitor canary for 24h - then promote to prod

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: argocd/sync gpupool-modulerefs-canary -> cluster: canary-us-west

jamal (sre): Add a rollout-hook to revert if GPU node drain succeeds? Also tie a Prometheus alert for `gpupool_unavailable` >5m

olivia (infra-eng): will add alert, and a quick rollback playbook. Also flagging cost impact: changing regional capacity map may increase reserved GPU costs; I'll add an estimate in PR description

marie (platform): sounds good. please include a tf plan output for a region with < 10 nodes to show no replacement

olivia (infra-eng): will attach plan + `terraform state list | grep aws_kms_alias` before/after steps. Opening draft PR in ~1h :thumbsup:

jamal (sre): thanks, will review and run migration script in staging once PR is up

argo-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-gpupool-mods/pull/456 (draft)

olivia (infra-eng): linking migration runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpupool-kms-migration

jamal (sre): noted. one more ask: add an input var to disable alias split for existing customers (opt-out) so we can roll per-customer if needed

olivia (infra-eng): good call. adding var `kms_alias_migration = true` default true

marie (platform): ok from platform side, ready to approve after migration doc + plan. :ok_hand:
